questions.prompt: Can you describe a book that inspired you?
questions.sampleA1: I like books. I read a book. It was good.
questions.sampleA2: I read a book. It was about history. I liked it because it was interesting.
questions.sampleB1: I read a book called "Sapiens." It was about the history of humans. For example, it talked about how we used to live. However, it was very long. I learned a lot from it.
questions.sampleB2: To be honest, the book that really inspired me was Sapiens by Yuval Noah Harari. It completely turned my thinking around about human history, and I found it hard to put down. I suppose what struck me most was how it ties together biology and culture, and it's stayed with me ever since. I'd highly recommend it.
questions.uzSampleA1: Men kitoblarni yaxshi ko'raman. Men bir kitob o'qiganman. U yaxshi edi.
questions.uzSampleA2: Men bir kitob o'qiganman. U tarix haqida edi. Menga yoqdi, chunki u qiziqarli edi.
questions.uzSampleB1:
Men "Sapiens" degan kitobni o'qiganman. U insoniyat tarixi haqida edi.
Masalan, unda biz qanday yashaganligimiz haqida gapirilgan.
Biroq, u juda uzun edi. Men undan ko'p narsalarni o'rgandim.
questions.uzSampleB2:
Meni ilhomlantirgan kitob "Sapiens" edi. U insoniyat tarixi haqida. U meni narsalar haqida boshqacha o'ylashga majbur qildi.
Xususan, u meni taraqqiyot haqidagi ba'zi taxminlarimni so'roq ostiga qo'yishga undadi. Men uni tarix va falsafaga qiziquvchilarga tavsiya qilaman.

vocabulary.title: Can you describe...
sentenceStarters: "A book that inspired me was..." - "Meni ilhomlantirgan kitob..."
"I was really inspired by..." - "Menga ... juda katta ilhom berdi"
"One book that comes to mind is..." - "Esimga kelgan bir kitob..."

questions.sampleAnswer:
A book that profoundly inspired me was "Sapiens" by Yuval Noah Harari. It's a sweeping historical account of humankind, and essentially, it reframed my understanding of our species' journey.

What struck me most was Harari's ability to connect seemingly disparate events and trends, illustrating how culture, technology, and biology have fed into one another to shape our present. It made me think twice about the narratives we often take for granted. I also appreciated its unflinching look at the darker aspects of human history, warts and all, prompting a more nuanced perspective on progress.

The book ultimately inspired me to adopt a more interdisciplinary approach to learning and to question assumptions. It's a book that stays with you long after you've finished reading, planting seeds of curiosity and critical thought.
questions.uzSampleAnswer:
Menga chuqur ilhom bergan kitob Yuval Noah Hararining "Sapiens" asari bo'ldi. Bu insoniyatning keng qamrovli tarixiy bayoni bo'lib, mohiyatan, u bizning turimizning sayohati haqidagi tushunchamni qayta shakllantirdi.

Meni eng ko'p hayratga solgani Hararining bir-biriga aloqasi yo'qdek tuyulgan voqealar va tendentsiyalarni bog'lay olishi, madaniyat, texnologiya va biologiya bir-biriga qanday ta'sir o'tkazib, bizning hozirgi holatimizni shakllantirganini ko'rsatib berishi bo'ldi. Bu biz ko'pincha o'z-o'zidan qabul qiladigan hikoyalar haqida ikki marta o'ylab ko'rishga majbur qildi. Men uning insoniyat tarixining qorong'u tomonlariga, barcha kamchiliklari bilan, murosasiz nazar tashlashini ham qadrladim, bu esa taraqqiyotga nisbatan yanada nozik nuqtai nazarni uyg'otdi.

Kitob, oxir-oqibat, meni o'rganishga nisbatan ko'proq fanlararo yondashuvni qabul qilishga va taxminlarni shubha ostiga olishga ilhomlantirdi. Bu o'qib bo'lganingizdan keyin ham uzoq vaqt siz bilan qoladigan, qiziquvchanlik va tanqidiy fikrlash urug'larini ekadigan kitobdir.

questions.prompt: Can you describe a school or college you like?
questions.sampleA1: I like my school. It is big. I have friends there.
questions.sampleA2: I like my school because it's fun. I have many friends, and we play together. My teacher is nice too.
questions.sampleB1: I like my college very much. It has a big library and many classrooms. For example, the teachers are very helpful. However, sometimes it's crowded. I enjoy studying there.
questions.sampleB2: I'd have to say my university is a place I'm really fond of. The campus is lovely, and the lecturers genuinely go out of their way to help. What I like most is the buzzing atmosphere — there's always something going on. The workload can be pretty demanding, to be honest, but it pushes me to do my best.
questions.uzSampleA1: Menga maktabim yoqadi. U katta. U yerda do'stlarim bor.
questions.uzSampleA2: Menga maktabim yoqadi, chunki u qiziqarli. Menda ko'p do'stlarim bor va biz birga o'ynaymiz. O'qituvchim ham yaxshi.
questions.uzSampleB1: Menga kollejim juda yoqadi. Unda katta kutubxona va ko'p sinf xonalari bor. Masalan, o'qituvchilar juda yordam berishadi. Biroq, ba'zida u yerda odam ko'p bo'ladi. Men u yerda o'qishdan zavqlanaman.
questions.uzSampleB2:
Men o'z universitetimni juda yaxshi ko'raman. Kampus juda go'zal va professorlar bilimdon.
Ayniqsa, meni ko'proq o'rganishga undaydigan qiyin kurs ishlaridan zavqlanaman. Bu intellektual o'sish uchun ajoyib muhit va men o'zimni kelajakdagi kareramga tayyor his qilaman.

vocabulary.title: Can you describe...
sentenceStarters: "I really like..." - "Menga ... juda yoqadi"
"A place I like is..." - "Menga yoqadigan joy bu..."
"I have fond memories of..." - "Menda ... haqida yaxshi xotiralar bor"

questions.sampleAnswer:
The school I fondly remember is my high school, a place that holds a special place in my heart. It wasn't just the academics, although they were certainly rigorous. It was the vibrant community, the dedicated teachers who went the extra mile, and the sense of belonging that pervaded the atmosphere.

The school had a strong emphasis on extracurricular activities, offering a wide range of clubs and sports. This allowed me to explore my interests and develop skills outside the classroom. Moreover, the school fostered a culture of intellectual curiosity and encouraged students to challenge themselves.

I remember the school fondly because it was a formative environment that shaped me into the person I am today. It instilled in me a love of learning, a sense of social responsibility, and the confidence to pursue my goals. It was, in a nutshell, a great place to grow up.
questions.uzSampleAnswer:
Men iliqlik bilan eslaydigan maktab – bu mening o‘rta maktabim, qalbimda alohida o‘rin egallagan joy. Gap faqatgina o‘qishda emas edi, garchi u yerda o‘qish qiyin bo‘lsada. Gap jonli jamoada, fidoyi o‘qituvchilarda edi, ular qo‘shimcha harakat qilishardi va muhitda hukmron bo‘lgan mansublik hissi edi.

Maktabda sinfdan tashqari mashg‘ulotlarga katta e’tibor qaratilgan bo‘lib, turli xil klublar va sport turlari taklif etilardi. Bu menga o‘z qiziqishlarimni o‘rganishga va sinfdan tashqari ko‘nikmalarni rivojlantirishga imkon berdi. Bundan tashqari, maktab intellektual qiziqish madaniyatini rivojlantirdi va o‘quvchilarni o‘zlariga talab qo‘yishga undadi.

Men maktabni iliqlik bilan eslayman, chunki u meni bugungi shaxs sifatida shakllantirgan muhit edi. U menga o‘rganishga muhabbat, ijtimoiy mas’uliyat hissi va maqsadlarimga erishish uchun ishonchni singdirdi. Qisqasi, u ulg‘ayish uchun ajoyib joy edi.

questions.sampleA1: Teamwork is good. We learn together. It is fun.
questions.sampleA2: Teamwork is good because we share ideas. We learn together and help each other. It is better than working alone.
questions.sampleB1: Teamwork helps us learn better. When we work together, we share ideas. For example, we can help each other with homework. However, sometimes it's hard to agree. But it's still good.
questions.sampleB2: Well, I think teamwork improves learning because you get to bounce ideas off each other. When you're stuck, a classmate often sees it from a different angle. It also keeps you motivated — you don't want to let the group down. Explaining something to a teammate is also a great way to cement your own understanding. As they say, two heads are better than one.
questions.uzSampleA1: Jamoaviy ish yaxshi. Biz birga o'rganamiz. Bu qiziqarli.
questions.uzSampleA2: Jamoaviy ish yaxshi, chunki biz fikrlarimizni baham ko'ramiz. Biz birgalikda o'rganamiz va bir-birimizga yordam beramiz. Bu yolg'iz ishlashdan yaxshiroq.
questions.uzSampleB1:
Jamoaviy ish bizga yaxshiroq o'rganishga yordam beradi. Birgalikda ishlaganimizda, biz fikrlarimizni baham ko'ramiz.
Masalan, biz bir-birimizga uy vazifalarida yordam berishimiz mumkin.
Biroq, ba'zan kelishish qiyin bo'ladi. Lekin baribir bu yaxshi.
questions.uzSampleB2:
Jamoaviy ish hamkorlikni rivojlantirish orqali o'rganishni yaxshilaydi. Talabalar birgalikda ishlaganda, ular turli xil g'oyalar va nuqtai nazarlarni baham ko'rishlari mumkin.
Bundan tashqari, bu kommunikatsiya ko'nikmalarini rivojlantirishga yordam beradi. Guruh bo'lib muammolarni hal qilish materialni yaxshiroq tushunishga olib kelishi mumkin.

vocabulary.title: How can teamwork...
idioms: bring diverse perspectives - "turli nuqtai nazarlarni olib kelmoq"
two heads are better than one - "ikki bosh bir boshdan yaxshi"
sentenceStarters: "Teamwork can improve..." - "Jamoaviy ish ... ni yaxshilashi mumkin"
"Working together helps..." - "Birgalikda ishlash ... ga yordam beradi"
"Teamwork is important because..." - "Jamoaviy ish muhim, chunki..."

questions.sampleAnswer:
Teamwork can significantly improve learning by fostering collaboration and shared understanding. When students work together, they bring diverse perspectives and skills to the table, enriching the learning experience for everyone involved. This collaborative environment encourages active participation and critical thinking, leading to a deeper understanding of the subject matter.

Furthermore, teamwork promotes communication and problem-solving skills. Students learn to articulate their ideas clearly, listen to others' viewpoints, and work through disagreements constructively. This not only enhances their academic performance but also prepares them for future collaborations in the workplace and beyond.

Ultimately, the synergy created through teamwork can lead to more creative and innovative solutions. By bouncing ideas off one another and challenging each other's assumptions, students can come up with solutions that they might not have been able to achieve individually. Two heads are better than one, as they say.
questions.uzSampleAnswer:
Jamoaviy ish hamkorlik va umumiy tushunishni rivojlantirish orqali o'rganishni sezilarli darajada yaxshilashi mumkin. Talabalar birgalikda ishlaganda, ular har bir ishtirokchi uchun o'rganish tajribasini boyitib, turli nuqtai nazarlar va ko'nikmalarni olib keladilar. Ushbu hamkorlik muhiti faol ishtirok etish va tanqidiy fikrlashni rag'batlantiradi, bu esa mavzuni chuqurroq tushunishga olib keladi.

Bundan tashqari, jamoaviy ish kommunikatsiya va muammolarni hal qilish ko'nikmalarini rivojlantiradi. Talabalar o'z fikrlarini aniq ifoda etishni, boshqalarning nuqtai nazarini tinglashni va kelishmovchiliklarni konstruktiv tarzda hal qilishni o'rganadilar. Bu nafaqat ularning akademik ko'rsatkichlarini yaxshilaydi, balki ularni kelajakda ish joyida va undan tashqarida hamkorlik qilishga tayyorlaydi.

Nihoyat, jamoaviy ish orqali yaratilgan sinergiya yanada ijodiy va innovatsion yechimlarga olib kelishi mumkin. Bir-birlarining fikrlarini muhokama qilib, bir-birlarining taxminlarini shubha ostiga qo'yish orqali, talabalar individual ravishda erisha olmagan yechimlarni topishlari mumkin. Aytishlaricha, "ikki bosh bir boshdan yaxshi".

questions.prompt: Describe what is happening in each photo.
questions.sampleA1: Photo one: Family painting. Photo two: Painters painting.
questions.sampleA2: In the first photo, the family is painting their house. In the second photo, painters are painting the house. The painters are professionals.
questions.sampleB1: In the first photo, a family is painting their house together. They look happy. For example, the children are helping. However, in the second photo, professional painters are painting a house. They are using ladders and brushes.
questions.sampleB2: So, both photos show a house being painted, but the mood couldn't be more different. In the first, a whole family is pitching in to paint their pale-blue house themselves — the dad's up a ladder with a roller and the kids are covered in paint, clearly having a whale of a time. In the second, three professional painters in white overalls and harnesses are working on a grey house with ladders and scaffolding — much more neat and methodical. The difference is that the first is a fun family DIY project, while the second is a proper paid job.
questions.uzSampleA1: Birinchi rasm: Oila rasm chizmoqda. Ikkinchi rasm: Rassomlar rasm chizmoqda.
questions.uzSampleA2:
Birinchi suratda, oila o'z uyini bo'yamoqda.
Ikkinchi suratda, bo'yoqchilar uyini bo'yashmoqda. Bo'yoqchilar - professionallar.
questions.uzSampleB1: Birinchi suratda bir oila birgalikda o'z uylarini bo'yashmoqda. Ular baxtiyor ko'rinishadi. Masalan, bolalar yordam berishyapti. Biroq, ikkinchi suratda professional rassomlar uy bo'yashmoqda. Ular narvonlar va cho'tkalardan foydalanishmoqda.
questions.uzSampleB2:
Birinchi suratda oila o'z uylarini DIY loyihasi sifatida bo'yayotganini ko'rsatadi. Ularga bu yoqayotgandek tuyuladi.
Bunga zid o'laroq, ikkinchi suratda professional rassomlar uyni bo'yayotganini ko'rsatadi.
Aniqki, ular maxsus uskunalar va texnikalardan foydalanishmoqda.

vocabulary.title: Describe what is...
idioms: killing two birds with one stone - "bir o'q bilan ikki quyonni urmoq"
sentenceStarters: "In the first photo, I can see..." - "Birinchi sur'atda men ko'ryapman..."
"The second photo shows..." - "Ikkinchi sur'atda ko'rsatilgan..."
"The main difference is..." - "Asosiy farq shundaki..."

questions.sampleAnswer:
In the first photo, we see a family happily engaged in a DIY project – painting their house. The atmosphere is one of collaboration and shared effort, with everyone, including the children, participating. They seem to be having a blast, suggesting that the project is not just about getting the job done but also about bonding as a family. The image evokes a sense of warmth, togetherness, and the satisfaction of creating something together.

The second photo contrasts sharply with the first. Here, we see professional painters at work, efficiently and methodically painting a house. The focus is on precision and expertise, with the painters using professional equipment and techniques. While the scene appears orderly and professional, it lacks the personal touch and sense of camaraderie evident in the first photo. It is a purely transactional relationship, with the painters providing a service for a fee.

Ultimately, the two photos illustrate different approaches to home improvement. The first emphasizes family involvement and shared experiences, killing two birds with one stone, while the second prioritizes efficiency and expertise. Both approaches have their merits, depending on the homeowner's priorities and resources.
questions.uzSampleAnswer:
Birinchi suratda biz oilaning uyini bo'yash kabi DIY loyihasi bilan xursandchilik bilan shug'ullanayotganini ko'ramiz. Atmosfera hamkorlik va umumiy sa'y-harakatlardan iborat bo'lib, unda hamma, shu jumladan bolalar ham ishtirok etmoqda. Ular juda xursand bo'lishayotganga o'xshaydi, bu loyiha shunchaki ishni bajarish emas, balki oila sifatida birlashish ekanligini ham ko'rsatadi. Surat iliqlik, birlik va birgalikda nimadir yaratishdan qoniqish hissini uyg'otadi.

Ikkinchi surat birinchisidan keskin farq qiladi. Bu yerda biz professional rassomlarning uyini samarali va uslubiy tarzda bo'yayotganini ko'ramiz. E'tibor aniqlik va tajribaga qaratilgan, rassomlar professional uskunalar va texnikalardan foydalanmoqda. Sahna tartibli va professional ko'rinsa-da, unda birinchi suratda ko'rinib turgan shaxsiy yondashuv va do'stona munosabat yetishmaydi. Bu shunchaki tranzaksion munosabat bo'lib, rassomlar to'lov evaziga xizmat ko'rsatmoqda.

Oxir oqibat, ikkala surat uy ta'miriga turli xil yondashuvlarni ko'rsatadi. Birinchisi oilaning ishtiroki va umumiy tajribasini ta'kidlaydi, bir o'q bilan ikki quyonni uradi, ikkinchisi esa samaradorlik va tajribaga ustuvor ahamiyat beradi. Ikkala yondashuv ham uy egasining ustuvorliklari va resurslariga qarab o'z afzalliklariga ega.

questions.prompt: What are the advantages of repairing something yourself instead of hiring a professional?
questions.sampleA1: I can save money. I can do it myself. It is good.
questions.sampleA2: It is cheaper if I do it. I can learn new things. But it is hard sometimes.
questions.sampleB1: It is cheaper to repair things yourself. For example, you don't have to pay someone. You can also learn new skills. However, it can take a lot of time. Sometimes it is better to hire a professional.
questions.sampleB2: Well, the obvious one is saving money — hiring a professional can run up a hefty bill, and doing it yourself cuts that out completely. On top of that, you pick up handy new skills and get a real sense of accomplishment once the job's done. To be honest, there's something satisfying about figuring things out for yourself rather than always relying on someone else.
questions.uzSampleA1: Men pulni tejashim mumkin. Men buni o'zim qila olaman. Bu yaxshi.
questions.uzSampleA2: Agar o'zim qilsam, arzonroq bo'ladi. Men yangi narsalarni o'rganishim mumkin. Lekin ba'zida qiyin bo'ladi.
questions.uzSampleB1: Narsalarni o'zingiz tuzatish arzonroq. Masalan, siz birovga pul to'lashingiz shart emas. Shuningdek, siz yangi ko'nikmalarni o'rganishingiz mumkin. Biroq, bu ko'p vaqt talab qilishi mumkin. Ba'zan mutaxassisni yollash yaxshiroq.
questions.uzSampleB2: Asosiy afzalliklardan biri, albatta, xarajatlarni tejashdir. Mutaxassislar qimmat bo'lishi mumkin. O'zingiz qilishingiz ko'p pulni tejashingizga yordam beradi. Bundan tashqari, siz yangi ko'nikmalarga ega bo'lasiz va o'zingizni muvaffaqiyatga erishgandek his qilasiz. Boshqa tomondan, bu ko'p vaqt talab qilishi mumkin va siz xatolarga yo'l qo'yishingiz mumkin. Bu o'zaro kelishuv.

vocabulary.title: What are the...
idioms: at the end of the day - "kun oxirida"
sentenceStarters: "One advantage is..." - "Bir afzalligi..."
"It's often cheaper to..." - "Ko'pincha ... arzonroq..."
"You also gain..." - "Siz ham olasiz..."

questions.sampleAnswer:
Well, obviously, the most immediate advantage is cost savings. Hiring a professional can run up quite a bill, especially for complex jobs. Doing it yourself cuts out the labor costs entirely. Beyond that, there's a real sense of accomplishment that comes with completing a repair or project yourself. It's empowering to learn new skills and figure things out.

Furthermore, you have complete control over the quality of the work. When you hire someone, you're trusting them to do a good job, but you're not always sure what you're going to get. Doing it yourself allows you to ensure that everything is done to your standards, and you can take your time to iron out any imperfections. At the end of the day, it's about saving money, gaining skills, and having control over the outcome.
questions.uzSampleAnswer:
Xo'sh, eng aniq afzalligi, albatta, xarajatlarni tejashdir. Mutaxassisni yollash, ayniqsa murakkab ishlar uchun, ancha qimmatga tushishi mumkin. O'zingiz qilishingiz ish haqi xarajatlarini butunlay yo'q qiladi. Bundan tashqari, ta'mirlash yoki loyihani o'zingiz yakunlash bilan bog'liq haqiqiy yutuq hissi bor. Yangi ko'nikmalarni o'rganish va nimanidir tushunib yetish juda kuch beradi.

Bundan tashqari, siz ish sifatini to'liq nazorat qilasiz. Kimnidir yollaganingizda, ularning yaxshi ish qilishiga ishonasiz, lekin har doim ham nima olishingizni aniq bilmaysiz. O'zingiz qilishingiz hamma narsa sizning standartlaringizga mos ravishda bajarilishini ta'minlashga imkon beradi va har qanday kamchiliklarni bartaraf etish uchun vaqt ajratishingiz mumkin. Oxir-oqibat, gap pulni tejash, ko'nikmalarni oshirish va natijani nazorat qilish haqida.

questions.prompt: Why is the "DIY" (Do It Yourself) culture becoming more popular in the modern world?
questions.sampleA1: DIY is good. It is easy. I like it.
questions.sampleA2: DIY is popular because it is cheap. You can learn new things, and it is fun.
questions.sampleB1: DIY is becoming more popular. For example, people want to save money. They also want to learn new skills. However, it can be difficult. You need to have time.
questions.sampleB2: I suppose there are a few reasons. For one, people are keen to cut down on costs and be more self-sufficient. What's more, the internet has made it dead easy — there's a tutorial for practically everything, so you can learn almost any skill from home. And the thing is, there's a growing appreciation for handmade, one-of-a-kind items in a world of mass production.
questions.uzSampleA2: DIY mashhurligi, chunki u arzon. Siz yangi narsalarni o'rganishingiz mumkin va bu qiziqarli.
questions.uzSampleB1:
DIY tobora ommalashib bormoqda.
Masalan, odamlar pulni tejashni xohlashadi. Ular, shuningdek, yangi ko'nikmalarni o'rganishni xohlashadi.
Biroq, bu qiyin bo'lishi mumkin. Sizda vaqt bo'lishi kerak.
questions.uzSampleB2:
DIY madaniyati bir necha sabablarga ko'ra ommalashib bormoqda.
Birinchidan, odamlar pulni tejashni va o'ziga ko'proq ishonchni xohlashadi.
Ikkinchidan, internet o'quv qo'llanmalari va ma'lumotlarga oson kirish imkoniyatini beradi.
Bundan tashqari, qo'lda yasalgan narsalarga nisbatan hurmat ortib bormoqda.
Ehtiyoj ixtironing onasidir.

vocabulary.title: Why is the...
sentenceStarters: "One reason is..." - "Bir sabab..."
"The internet makes it easier to..." - "Internet ... qilishni osonlashtiradi..."
"People want to be more..." - "Odamlar ko'proq ... bo'lishni xohlashadi..."

questions.sampleAnswer:
The rise of DIY culture, I think, is multifaceted. Firstly, there's a growing desire for self-sufficiency and a rejection of consumerism. People want to be less reliant on corporations and more in control of their own lives. DIY offers a way to take back that control, whether it's through making your own clothes, growing your own food, or repairing your own appliances.

Secondly, the internet has made DIY incredibly accessible. There are countless tutorials, forums, and online communities dedicated to every imaginable project. This means that anyone can learn to do just about anything, regardless of their background or skill level. The world is your oyster when it comes to information. Finally, there's a growing appreciation for craftsmanship and handmade goods. In a world of mass-produced items, people are seeking out unique, personalized items that reflect their own individuality. DIY allows them to create things that are truly one-of-a-kind.
questions.uzSampleAnswer:
O'z-o'zing qil madaniyatining yuksalishi, menimcha, ko'p qirrali. Birinchidan, o'ziga yetarlilikka bo'lgan istakning ortishi va iste'molchilikni rad etish mavjud. Odamlar korporatsiyalarga kamroq bog'liq bo'lishni va o'z hayotlarini ko'proq nazorat qilishni xohlashadi. O'z-o'zing qil o'z kiyimingizni tikish, o'z oziq-ovqatingizni yetishtirish yoki o'z jihozlaringizni ta'mirlash orqali o'sha nazoratni qaytarib olishning usulini taklif etadi.

Ikkinchidan, internet o'z-o'zing qilni nihoyatda ommabop qildi. Har qanday tasavvurga ega loyiha uchun bag'ishlangan son-sanoqsiz qo'llanmalar, forumlar va onlayn hamjamiyatlar mavjud. Bu shuni anglatadiki, har kim o'zining kelib chiqishi yoki mahorat darajasidan qat'i nazar, deyarli har qanday narsani o'rganishi mumkin. Ma'lumot borasida imkoniyatlar cheksiz. Nihoyat, hunarmandchilik va qo'lda yasalgan mahsulotlarni qadrlash ortib bormoqda. Ommaviy ishlab chiqarilgan mahsulotlar dunyosida odamlar o'z shaxsiyatini aks ettiruvchi noyob, shaxsiylashtirilgan mahsulotlarni qidirmoqdalar. O'z-o'zing qil ularga haqiqatan ham yagona bo'lgan narsalarni yaratishga imkon beradi.

questions.prompt: Describe a time you spent time working or living in a rural area (village).
questions.sampleA1: I went to a village. It was good. I liked the animals.
questions.sampleA2: I lived in a village. It was quiet and nice. I liked it because it was different.
questions.sampleB1: I spent time in a rural area. It was very different from the city. For example, it was very quiet. I felt more relaxed there. However, it was also boring sometimes. I missed the city.
questions.sampleB2: Right, so a couple of years ago I spent a whole summer staying with my grandparents in a small village up in the mountains, and looking back, it was one of the best decisions I've ever made. To be honest, at first I thought I'd be bored stiff — no shopping malls, no fast internet, nothing much to do. But it turned out to be exactly what I needed. I helped out on the family plot, feeding the animals and picking fruit, and there was something genuinely satisfying about working with my hands and seeing the fruits of my labour at the end of each day. The change of scenery did wonders for my mental health. In the city, I'd always felt wound up and on edge, constantly rushing around and glued to my phone. Out in the countryside, everything slowed right down. The fresh air, the quiet and the slower pace all helped me switch off and properly recharge my batteries. I slept like a log and honestly felt like a huge weight had lifted off my shoulders. As for why city people are increasingly drawn to green activities like gardening or volunteering outdoors, I suppose it comes down to the fact that urban life can feel completely disconnected from nature. People are crying out for a bit of peace and a way to wind down. Getting your hands in the soil is therapeutic — it's a chance to escape the concrete jungle and reconnect with something real. At the end of the day, we all need that balance.

bulletPoints: Describe a time you spent time working or living in a rural area (village).
How did this change of environment affect your mental health compared to city life?
Why are urban people increasingly seeking "green activities" like gardening or volunteering in nature?
questions.sampleAnswer:
I spent about three months working on an organic farm in the mountains, a few hours away from any major city. The experience was a real eye-opener. The days were long and physically demanding – planting, weeding, harvesting – but there was a profound sense of satisfaction in working with the land and seeing the fruits of your labor. The village itself was small, with a close-knit community where everyone knew each other and looked out for one another. Frankly, it was a world away from the hustle and bustle of city life.

The change of environment had a surprisingly positive impact on my mental health. In the city, I often felt stressed and overwhelmed by the constant noise and demands. Out in the countryside, things slowed down considerably. The fresh air, the sounds of nature, and the physical activity all helped to clear my head and reduce my anxiety. I found myself sleeping better, feeling more relaxed, and appreciating the simple things in life. It was like a weight had been lifted.

Urban people are increasingly seeking "green activities" because they're yearning for that connection with nature that's often missing in city life. Gardening, volunteering in nature reserves – these activities provide an escape from the concrete jungle and allow people to reconnect with the natural world. They offer a chance to de-stress, exercise, and experience the therapeutic benefits of being outdoors. Ultimately, it’s about finding a balance between urban living and the restorative power of nature.

You don't know what you've got till it's gone, and many city dwellers don't realize how much they miss nature until they actively seek it out.
questions.uzSampleAnswer:
Men tog‘li hududda, har qanday katta shahardan bir necha soat uzoqlikda joylashgan organik fermada taxminan uch oy ishladim. Bu tajriba haqiqatan ham ko‘zimni ochdi. Kunlar uzun va jismonan og‘ir edi – ekish, o‘toq qilish, hosil yig‘ish – lekin yer bilan ishlash va o‘z mehnating samaralarini ko‘rishdan chuqur qoniqish hissi bor edi. Qishloqning o‘zi kichik edi, hamma bir-birini taniydigan va bir-biriga g‘amxo‘rlik qiladigan ahil jamoa bor edi. Ochig‘ini aytsam, bu shahar hayotining shovqinidan butunlay uzoq olam edi.

Atrof-muhitning o‘zgarishi mening ruhiy salomatligimga hayratlanarli darajada ijobiy ta’sir ko‘rsatdi. Shaharda men ko‘pincha doimiy shovqin va talablardan stressga tushib, o‘zimni bosimsiz his qilardim. Qishloqda esa ishlar sezilarli darajada sekinlashdi. Toza havo, tabiatning ovozlari va jismoniy faollikning barchasi fikrimni tozalashga va xavotirimni kamaytirishga yordam berdi. Men yaxshiroq uxlayotganimni, o‘zimni xotirjamroq his qilayotganimni va hayotning oddiy narsalarini qadrlayotganimni angladim. Go‘yo yelkamdan tog‘ ag‘darilgandek bo‘ldi.

Shaharliklar tobora ko‘proq "yashil faoliyatlar"ni izlashmoqda, chunki ular shahar hayotida ko‘pincha yetishmaydigan tabiat bilan aloqani sog‘inishadi. Bog‘dorchilik, tabiat qo‘riqxonalarida ko‘ngilli bo‘lish – bu faoliyatlar beton o‘rmondan qochish imkoniyatini beradi va odamlarga tabiat olami bilan qayta bog‘lanishga imkon beradi. Ular stressdan xalos bo‘lish, mashq qilish va ochiq havoda bo‘lishning terapevtik foydalarini his qilish imkoniyatini beradi. Oxir oqibat, gap shahar hayoti va tabiatning tiklovchi kuchi o‘rtasida muvozanatni topish haqida.

Bor narsangni yo‘qotmaguningcha qadriga yetmaysan, ko‘plab shaharliklar tabiatni faol ravishda izlamaguncha, uni qanchalik sog‘inishlarini anglamaydilar.

questions.prompt: Physical Money Should Be Completely Replaced by Digital Currency
questions.sampleA1: Digital money is good. It is easy to use. But maybe it is not safe.
questions.sampleA2: Digital money is good because it is easy. But it can be dangerous because of hackers. Old people don't like it.
questions.sampleB1: Digital money can reduce crime. For example, it is easier to track. It is also convenient for travel. However, there is a risk of cyber-attacks. Elderly people might not like it.
questions.sampleB2: Well, this is a real hot-button issue, and I can see valid points on both sides. On the one hand, there's a strong case for going fully digital. For a start, it could clamp down on crime — digital transactions leave a trail, so theft and dodgy dealings become much harder to get away with. It's also incredibly convenient; you can travel abroad or shop online without ever fumbling for cash, which is a real bonus for anyone who travels a lot. And on top of that, governments would save a fortune they currently fork out on printing and moving paper money around. That said, I do have my reservations. The biggest worry, for me, is security. A fully digital system would be a prime target for hackers, and if it ever went down, the whole economy could grind to a halt. There's also the digital divide to think about — a lot of elderly people simply aren't tech-savvy and would really struggle to keep up; imagine my grandmother trying to pay for her groceries with an app. And perhaps most worryingly, you'd wave goodbye to your privacy, because every single penny you spend could be tracked. So where do I stand? Personally, I think we're heading towards a largely cashless society anyway, and honestly I'm mostly in favour; the direction of travel is pretty clear, and younger generations have already all but abandoned cash. But I'd stop short of scrapping cash altogether — I reckon we should keep physical money as a backup, at least for now. Better safe than sorry, as they say.

questions.sampleAnswer:
Undoubtedly, the idea of completely replacing physical money with digital currency is a complex one with valid arguments on both sides. On the one hand, the proponents of digital currency highlight the potential for reduced crime. The argument is that digital transactions are easier to track, making it more difficult for criminals to engage in theft and illegal transactions. Moreover, digital currency offers convenience for international travel and online shopping, streamlining transactions and reducing the need for currency exchange. Furthermore, the elimination of physical money would save the costs associated with printing, storing, and transporting paper money.

However, there are significant concerns that need to be addressed. The risk of cyber-attacks and system failures is a major issue. A widespread digital currency system would be a prime target for hackers, and any system failure could have catastrophic consequences for the economy. In addition to that, elderly people and those without access to technology may struggle to adapt to a completely digital system, creating a digital divide. Perhaps most importantly, the loss of privacy is a serious concern. Every digital transaction can be tracked, giving governments and corporations unprecedented access to our financial lives. All things considered, while the benefits of digital currency are appealing, the risks and challenges are substantial and need careful consideration.
questions.uzSampleAnswer:
Shubhasiz, jismoniy pulni toʻliq raqamli valyuta bilan almashtirish gʻoyasi murakkab boʻlib, har ikki tomonning ham asosli dalillari mavjud. Bir tomondan, raqamli valyuta tarafdorlari jinoyatchilikning kamayish ehtimolini taʼkidlashadi. Ularning fikricha, raqamli tranzaksiyalarni kuzatish osonroq, bu esa jinoyatchilarning oʻgʻirlik va noqonuniy operatsiyalar bilan shugʻullanishini qiyinlashtiradi. Bundan tashqari, raqamli valyuta xalqaro sayohatlar va onlayn xaridlar uchun qulaylik yaratadi, tranzaksiyalarni soddalashtiradi va valyuta ayirboshlash zaruratini kamaytiradi. Qolaversa, jismoniy pulning yoʻq qilinishi qogʻoz pulni chop etish, saqlash va tashish bilan bogʻliq xarajatlarni tejaydi.

Biroq, hal qilinishi kerak boʻlgan muhim xavotirlar mavjud. Kiberhujumlar va tizim ishdan chiqishi xavfi asosiy muammo hisoblanadi. Keng tarqalgan raqamli valyuta tizimi xakerlar uchun asosiy nishon boʻladi va har qanday tizimning ishdan chiqishi iqtisodiyot uchun halokatli oqibatlarga olib kelishi mumkin. Bundan tashqari, keksa odamlar va texnologiyalardan foydalanish imkoniyati boʻlmaganlar toʻliq raqamli tizimga moslashishda qiynalishi, raqamli tafovutni yaratishi mumkin. Ehtimol, eng muhimi, shaxsiy hayotning yoʻqolishi jiddiy tashvishdir. Har bir raqamli tranzaksiyani kuzatish mumkin, bu esa hukumatlar va korporatsiyalarga bizning moliyaviy hayotimizga misli koʻrilmagan darajada kirish imkonini beradi. Barcha omillarni hisobga olgan holda, raqamli valyutaning afzalliklari jozibador boʻlsa-da, xavf va muammolar sezilarli va ularni diqqat bilan koʻrib chiqish kerak.
